items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: If I walked on Charlie Creath's bandstand or Dewey Jackson's bandstand

ctx.x: Shorty Baker? No, Shorty's younger. Beautiful trumpet player. That's a funny thing that happened. It's around '28, too. There's a cab driver. So, ... I go to jam sessions. I made out all right. Of course, I had some ideas of what to do.

Let me tell you about Charlie Creath. I'm going to get back to Shorty Baker, too. This is my boy, you know. So, we sat down one night -- about 5, 6 trumpet players, just a country boy, hmmm. Only tune I knew was a couple of tunes but I didn't do it on my own. I was invited. And it do make a an a difference. It's a difference between/amateur and/professional -- your thought. If I walked on Charlie Creath's bandstand or Dewey Jackson's bandstand, do you know what they do me -- throw me off bodily right in the…
